csv_scope_of_work: Front Range Community College is requesting proposals from architectural/engineering firms for audits of facilities and campus infrastructure at our Westminster and Larimer campuses. It is the desire of the college to have teams created prior to the proposals being submitted to ensure there is sufficient architectural and engineering expertise to complete the requested audits. Proposals will be due after mandatory site tours of the facilities involved. The selected vendor will engage with stakeholders to ensure a comprehensive understanding of the current and future use and needs of the facilities. The purpose of the building audits is to gather information, perform assessments as defined by the Office of State Architect (OSA), identify critical deficiencies, and work with the College s Facilities Planning and Management (FPM) and Facilities Operations staff to identify, quantify and prioritize projects to be submitted to the State for Controlled Maintenance funding. Deliverables must support immediate submission into State Controlled Maintenance and capital planning processes, including fully prioritized, cost validated, and risk ranked project lists. All data must be delivered in a structured, machine-readable format suitable for being incorporated into capital planning systems. The selected vendor must describe how the FCA outputs integrate with enterprise systems and long-term capital funding. Cost estimations must include escalation and phasing assumptions. This site survey includes but is not limited to all utilities (water, sewer, stormwater, gas, electric) IT/Telecom infrastructure, roadways, parking, and drainage. All structures reviewed should be viewed in the context of the college as a whole regardless of which campus they rest on. The selected consultant team will be expected to follow the audit report format required by the College/Office of State Architect. The college will make available previous audits for your reference as an example of a report. Auto cad drawings or pdf drawings are available for most of these facilities.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Cost Estimating, Inspection Services, Planning/Master Planning
